problems: Table lacks separate columns for unit type, floor, rooms count, beds/baths split, interior/exterior sf, and a single tax_m/tax_a — I mapped "No. of Rooms & Baths" to rooms field as printed (e.g. "3.5/1.5") since format is unclear (likely rooms/baths, not beds/baths), left beds/baths blank per instructions for unclear codes. Approx Sq. Ft. Area placed in int_sf; units 2 and 3 are marked "1547 B" meaning balcony, so ext_sf could not be isolated as a separate number and is left blank per instructions, with "B denotes Balcony" noted. Used col 9 (Including 421a) as cc_m/cc_a and tax_m/tax_a since it is listed before the "Assuming No" column; tax2_m holds the "Assuming No Section 421a" monthly tax. No separate "carry_m" deductible column was used for carry_m field (cols 11/12) since instructions define carry_m as monthly carrying charges, which I took from col 9's monthly figure (duplicate of cc_m) — columns 10-12 (Assuming No 421a carrying charges, and the two deductible-for-tax-purposes variants) are not individually captured in the fixed 20-cell U-line format.
